Version 1.0.1 of manual-to-solution

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Documentation and feature descriptions remain unchanged.
- Functionality and workflow continue as previously specified.

manual-to-solution v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for converting software/system operation manuals into professional solution proposal documents.
- Provides full workflow: manual parsing, gap analysis, solution design, value mapping, diagram generation, and final DOCX assembly.
- Supports extraction of system features, user roles, business flows, and technical characteristics from uploaded manuals.
- Outputs: editable Markdown, formal DOCX files with standard diagrams, and individual PNG image files for documentation.
- Includes customizable industry focus and compliance mapping, diagram generation with matplotlib, and DOCX styling options.
